assumptions: Quality performance standard met (quality_score 1.0); under the alternative standard the sharing rate is multiplied by the ACO's quality score.
Levels C-E: MSR/MLR defaults to the variable (population-based) election; a stated MSR replaces it.
The revenue-based loss limit applies only when participant_revenue is supplied; otherwise the benchmark-based cap bounds losses.
Benchmark is contract-specific and must be supplied; regional adjustment, ACPT and the risk-score cap are already inside a CMS-issued benchmark.

msr_schedule.unit: MSR by assigned beneficiaries, linearly interpolated within a band (one-sided levels; also the variable MSR/MLR election for two-sided levels)

two_sided_msr_mlr_elections.unit: symmetric MSR/MLR options, chosen for the agreement period

under_5000_rule.value: A fixed MSR/MLR switches to the variable MSR/MLR for any performance year with fewer than 5,000 assigned beneficiaries

low_revenue_below_msr.value: Low-revenue ACOs with >=5,000 assigned, below benchmark but under the MSR, share at one-half the sharing rate (agreement periods from 2024)

glide_path.value: Agreement periods starting 2024-2026: inexperienced ACOs may stay in the glide path for up to two agreement periods; from 1 Jan 2027 starts, one agreement period (max 5 one-sided performance years)
